spec.scene: A thick padded blue gym floor covers the ground, meeting a steep gray overhanging wall angled forward at the back. Bold purple climbing holds curve up the wall, slightly larger than life, flanked by a few scattered yellow and red grips. At the center top of the wall hangs a climber in a teal tank top, two hands planted on the final hold. Below on the right stands a companion in an orange shirt looking up with raised arms. Warm overhead gym lighting casts soft silhouettes across the wall.
spec.title: Purple V4 First Try
spec.caption: Finally sent the purple V4 on the overhang, first try.
